title: Sunlit 3BHK near Whitefield Metro
description: East-facing 3BHK on the 9th floor of a gated community, a 6-minute walk from Whitefield metro station. Two covered parking slots, clubhouse with pool and gym, and 24x7 power backup. Ready to move in.

title: Garden Villa in Sarjapur Road
description: Independent 4BHK villa with a private lawn, home office and terrace deck. Part of a 60-villa enclave with walking trails and close to top international schools on Sarjapur Road.

title: Compact 2BHK in Hinjewadi Phase 1
description: Well-planned 2BHK minutes from the Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park. Modular kitchen, balcony with hill views, and a society with children's play area and jogging track. Ideal first home for IT professionals.

title: Hillside Villa in Baner
description: Three-level villa on the slopes of Baner hill with a double-height living room and wraparound balconies. Quiet lane, yet close to Balewadi High Street cafés and the Mumbai–Bangalore highway.

title: Residential Plot in Wagholi
description: Clear-title NA plot in a gated layout with paved roads, underground drainage and street lighting. Rapidly developing area on the Pune–Ahmednagar highway.

title: Skyline 3BHK in Gachibowli
description: High-rise 3BHK with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Financial District. Amenities include a rooftop infinity pool, co-working lounge and EV charging. 10 minutes to HITEC City.

title: Gated Villa in Kokapet
description: Premium 5BHK villa with a private pool, home theatre and lift. Located in one of Hyderabad's fastest-appreciating neighbourhoods, close to the Outer Ring Road.

title: Corner Plot in Shamshabad
description: HMDA-approved east-facing corner plot near the international airport. Layout has 40-ft roads, a park and water connections already in place.

title: Breezy 2BHK in OMR Thoraipakkam
description: Cross-ventilated 2BHK on Old Mahabalipuram Road with easy access to the IT corridor. Rainwater harvesting, solar-powered common areas and a well-maintained society.

title: Courtyard Villa in ECR
description: Chettinad-inspired villa with a central open courtyard, Athangudi tile flooring and a short drive to the beach. A calm weekend-home feel with city conveniences nearby.

title: Sea-view 2BHK in Powai
description: Lake-facing 2BHK in Hiranandani Gardens with Italian marble flooring. Walking distance to schools, Galleria mall and the Powai lakefront promenade.

title: Starter 1BHK in Thane West
description: Efficient 1BHK in a new tower near Ghodbunder Road, with a balcony overlooking the Yeoor hills. Society offers gym, pool and round-the-clock security.
